positive_triggers: Convert my long single-file learning journal into topic-specific journals without losing history.
Move the problem history to the relevant topic records, preserve every row, and fix links.
negative_triggers: Summarize today's lesson without changing my journal.
Create a new private workspace even though I have not agreed to its location.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: In an isolated fixture, convert a monolithic journal containing 8 session entries and 5 problem-history rows spanning three topics. Preserve all dates and source links. One entry has an unclear topic. Keep the central LEARNING-JOURNAL.md as a short index and place detailed history beside topic materials. Do not delete the original until checks are complete. Report counts and link results; do not commit.
pass_criteria: Inventories all 8 session entries and all 5 problem-history rows before moving them.
Maps entries to topic journals using available evidence and does not silently force the unclear entry into a topic.
Preserves all entries, rows, dates, and source references, and fixes relative links affected by moves.
Leaves the central journal as a topic index with only cross-topic notes, updating relevant counts and instructions.
Compares source and destination counts and checks links before proposing retirement of the original.
Does not create unrelated personal files, commit, or push.
